## Context

- Dry run (product owner direction): the runner cannot take over yet. Five verified gaps:
  1. facilitator.py parse_task_force treats every bulleted "Name: ..." line in the Task force section as a role, so a card's Left out list, assignee note and domain-expert line make card mode refuse the card.
  2. loop.py always passes --repo as the loop root, so a card whose code lives in another repository (card 205 changes mob-defaults) cannot be run.
  3. loop.py --run requires --retro-cmd and --rerank-cmd and Avowry has neither: a per-card retro with feedback from every role, each in its own context, and a product manager re-rank that goes through a Decider.
  4. Probes are refreshed only at card start and at a cycle boundary when older than 60 minutes, but the audit-15 guardrail F-040 needs probes under 60 minutes old before every seat.
  5. loop_runner.py stops the loop with exit 5 on any blocking finding, with no exemption for a corrective card whose issue names the finding (card 205 adds that exemption to the facilitator only).
- Proposed split for the architect (one concern per card, each within the D136 limits, red first): 208a gap 1 (parse_task_force reads only role lines of the declared format; Left out, assignee note and domain-expert answer are not roles); 208b gap 2 (a separate card repository option, the loop root unchanged); 208c gap 5 (reuse the 205 corrective_gate_message in loop_runner.py); 208d gap 4 (probe before every seat); 208e gap 3 (Avowry retro and re-rank commands, the largest: itself likely two cards, retro then re-rank). Order: 208a, 208b, 208c, 208d, 208e. The architect may merge or reorder; this card is the parent that the split replaces, so the Done checks above bind the sum of the slices.
- Each slice records in mob-defaults with a reference to D145 and D136, red test first (D137), and cites F-008 so it is a corrective commit.
